verdict.rationale: Luma documents a public API with API-key management, a versioned /v1 base with a dated changelog, Python/JS/TS SDKs, per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the legacy reference, and a live Try-It panel against api.lumalabs.ai, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a standalone downloadable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json/yaml return 404) with machine-readable definitions on the current Agents API docs rather than only the legacy generation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the first-party API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
